LanguageData.LP_BarlguraLeap.label: leap strike
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraLeap.description: Leap next to a target within 8 cells; on landing, enemies within 1 cell make a Dexterity save (difficulty 13, base success 50%) or fall for 1 second. Cooldown 6 hours.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusKiss.label: charming kiss
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusKiss.description: Kiss an adjacent humanlike: the target makes a Wisdom save (difficulty rises with the succubus's proficiency bonus and Charisma; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success). On failure: enemies are charmed for 60 seconds; prisoners lose 15 recruit resistance; colonists gain +20 opinion of you. Those who succeed are immune for 24 hours. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_NabassuGaze.label: petrifying gaze
LanguageData.LP_NabassuGaze.description: Gaze at one person within 6 cells: they make a Constitution save (difficulty 14, base success 45%) or move speed ×0.5 for 10 seconds. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CambionGlide.label: gliding leap
LanguageData.LP_CambionGlide.description: Spread the small wings and glide to a spot within 6 cells. Cooldown 4 hours.
